entities.name: Sawar Muhammad Hussain
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sowar Muhammad Hussain Janjua, was a Pakistani soldier and the 8th recipient of Pakistan's highest military award, the Nishan-e-Haider, and the only soldier of the Pakistan Armoured Corps to be given this award.
